title: Wayfinder
provenance: Reported by AmarokSpiritch (highball#294, 2026-10-08 to 10-11), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21. Without a launch option the world stayed invisible on DXVK and DXMT stopped with Unreal's message that DirectX 12 is not supported. With -dx11 the player reports it works like a charm. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: An Unreal game that starts in DirectX 12, which DXMT and DXVK do not have. Highball passes -dx11 at Play so it starts in DirectX 11 and plays.

knownIssues.symptom: The world stays invisible, or the game stops saying DirectX 12 is not supported
knownIssues.cause: the game starts in DirectX 12, which DXMT and DXVK do not have
knownIssues.fix: start it with -dx11, which Highball now passes at Play
